note: Lower Big Blue NRD recreation area (NRD-operated, so local) on a 77-acre no-wake lake 6 mi E of Odell, SW of Wymore. The gravel camper pads sit in a herringbone row off the west park road, behind a tree belt from the lake; swim beach, boat ramp and dock, accessible restroom. Self-register at entry; one camper per electric site. --Claude
summary: Booking confirmed first-come with a 14-nights-in-30 limit (NRD camping rules). Fees $20 electric / $5 non-electric re-confirmed on the NRD page (left as stored, human-read provenance). Waterfront lead: lakefront looks too high - the pads sit behind a tree belt 25-50 m from the lake, or face the dike road and a sediment pond; downgrade proposed. Pin is on the pads (OK).
flags: WATERFRONT downgrade proposed (lakefront -> lakeview, or not waterfront if strict): on imagery the camper pads are a herringbone of ~20 angled gravel spurs off the west park road (40.0575,-96.6959). The northern spurs back onto a belt of trees along the lake's south shore, 25-50 m from open water; the southern spurs face the dike road and a small sediment basin (~4 acres, under the pond line) with trees between. Nothing is open shore with no road or trees between, so no on-water value is earned; a filtered lake view from the northern few pads is plausible but I have no campsite photos to show it. Per the unsure-downgrade rule I'd go to lakeview at most. The swim beach NE of the pads is day use and doesn't count.
